optimal.idea: Track depth; append a char unless it's an outermost '(' (depth 0) or ')' (depth 1).
Split on whitespace, drop empties, reverse the word order, join with single spaces.
Scan from the right for the last odd digit; the prefix up to it is the answer.
Running counter: +1 on '(', -1 on ')'; track the maximum reached.
Iteratively run-length-encode the previous term (count then digit).
Track open count and needed additions; ')' with no open needs an add, leftover opens add too.

brute.idea: Try all n rotations of s and compare to goal.

optimal.idea: s is a rotation of goal iff same length and s appears within goal+goal.
Compare 26-length character counts.
Maintain two consistent char→char mappings (s→t and t→s).
Count frequencies, then order characters by count (bucket or heap) and rebuild.

better.idea: DP table where dp[i][j] extends dp[i+1][j-1] when the ends match.

optimal.idea: Expand around each of the 2n-1 centers, tracking the longest palindrome.
Total substrings = n*(n+1)/2 (or count by first/last char rules for variants).
For each start, extend right maintaining a freq map; add (maxFreq - minFreq) each step.
Interval DP: dp[i][j] combines inner counts, adding 1 more when s[i]==s[j].
Sum values; subtract when a smaller numeral precedes a larger one.
Skip spaces, read optional sign, parse digits, clamp to int range.

brute.idea: Compare characters column by column across all strings until a mismatch.

optimal.idea: Sort and compare only the first vs last string; their common prefix covers all.
Repeat a until length covers b, try one extra copy; check b is a substring (Rabin-Karp/KMP).

brute.idea: Try matching the pattern at every text index.

optimal.idea: KMP: build the LPS array, then scan text without backtracking on mismatches.
Compute LPS of s + '#' + reverse(s); the unmatched suffix, reversed, is prepended.
The answer is the last value of the KMP LPS array (longest proper prefix = suffix).
Length-prefix each string as 'len#str'; decode by reading the length then that many chars.
